title: Balsall Creek
specs: Vineyard located on 35 acres in the Chehalem Mountains AVA
Focus on Pinot Noir and Chardonnay with unique varietals
Sustainably farmed, organic, Salmon Safe, Bee Friendly, dry-farmed, hand-harvested vineyard
Private events require Balsall Creek Club Membership or joining a membership tier

Private event spaces accommodate up to 150 guests
